updates.text:
Test Group

* The offer becomes available to the player at Level 10.
* The player sees three price points: $3, $5, and $20.
* The Starter Pack value will be more balanced and less generous
* The offer has a stock of 2 and expires either:

* After the player purchases it twice, or
* When the player reaches Level 74,
whichever happens first.

* A player who purchases the $20 FTD offer will receive the STD Offer at $25.
* Players who purchase any other FTD offer will receive the STD Offer at $20, the same as in the Control Group.

Control Group
-------------

* The player sees the same three price points: $3, $5, and $7

* The offer remains available until:

* The player reaches Level 30, or
* The player makes a purchase,
whichever happens first.

* The STD Offer remains priced at $20 for these players.
